Query Expansion All BioASQ questions are natural language interrogatives, which contain auxiliary and interrogative words (”are”, ”what”, ”does”, ”which”) that carry no discriminative retrieval signal and dilute the term-frequency weight of the relevant biomedical entities under the BM25 scoring function.
